note: B25 Office de tourisme, first floor: the country gallery (La galerie des pays), camera at the top of the stairs from the hall. Lavender-grey walls, white pilasters, green-and-white marble floor, bunting of plain flags; landmark: the brass armillary sphere in the bay window. Feminine LEFT (divider offset right, 5 of 7 gendered words are feminine): hippo at the front of the queue tearing a ticket at the striped border post (frontière); kangaroo, panda and fox holding hands under one blue flag (nation); dad planting a young tree in a pot (patrie); Frank kneeling by the globe on an old telephone (francophonie); lizard pushing a toy container ship along the track round a globe (mondialisation). CENTRE: two old men in matching berets patting each other on the back (compatriote, m/f). Masculine RIGHT: count in a velvet coat holding up a huge wheel of cheese (comté); wild boar trotting out of a model town gate (faubourg). Exits: stairs down near left -> hall R_world_01; panelled door back left -> geography classroom R_world_02_z1; double door back right -> orientation room R_abs_space_02; narrow stairs up far right -> attic R_world_03. Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p3).
